description: Admin UI surface for managing mcp_exemptions records in the Search-Driven UI (port 8790). Must read existing exemptions via registry_api on :8781, present as HTML table with columns: exemption_id, server_id, granted_by, valid_from, valid_until, rationale. Must include form for admin to create new exemption or extend existing. Write actions go through approval_workflow daemon via write_service, never directly to database.
